ai_policy.summary: The journal adopts COPE guidance covering AI in manuscript writing and collection and analysis of data, with disclosure and human accountability. It does not expressly address code assistance; confirmation is needed for the full analysis/code workflow.

disclosure.instructions: In Materials and Methods or a similar section identify the tool and explain how it was used for writing, graphical elements, or data collection and analysis.

restrictions: AI cannot be an author; authors remain responsible for content and must have permission for third-party content.
Code assistance is not specifically addressed.

ai_policy.summary: Publisher policy contemplates AI in study design or methodology and substantive manuscript contributions under human responsibility, but bars AI creation or alteration of research data, figures or experimental images. It does not clearly establish permission for analysis or code generation under that restriction.

disclosure.instructions: Describe AI used in study design or methodology in acknowledgements; disclose significant contributions to any part of the manuscript, identifying tools and how used. Simple proofreading and copy-editing need not be declared; disclose AI-assisted images at submission.

restrictions: Papers generated by AI are not accepted; AI cannot be an author.
Generative AI must not create, alter, manipulate or enhance research data, figures or experimental images.
Do not enter personal, confidential or sensitive data; restrictions apply to copyrighted material.
